# Agent Stack Optimizer

> Reversible, dependency-free setup for Claude Code and Codex that reduces token usage: context-threshold handoff guard, PDF/Office-to-text Read hook (markitdown), statusline, audit, usage reports and rollback.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): install, modules, flags, rollback, FAQ
- [Design](docs/design.md): architecture and decisions
- [Implementation plan](docs/implementation-plan.md)

## Code
- [stack.py](stack.py): CLI (audit, setup, check, report, run, backups, rollback)
- [hooks/](hooks): handoff guard, PDF/Office Read hook, statusline
- [skills/](skills): handoff, setup, markitdown
